note: Cartoon launch video. Beats play in order. voice: narrator (female), aarav (male, Hinglish), or none (text only). Myna (the assistant, built on the Bolo models) speaks only in text bubbles: it has no voice yet. Numbers in {BRACES} are filled from results/ before the narration is generated; spoken numbers are written as words. Each beat has a style: the TTS description is '<speaker> speaks in <style>, with very clear audio and no background noise.' Pitch and pace vary beat to beat so the narration never sounds flat.

beats.text: Meet Aarav. It is two in the morning, and his project is due tomorrow.
beats.style: a hushed, intriguing, storyteller voice, slightly low pitched and slow, like the start of a mystery

beats.caption: docker chalu karo!
beats.style: a tired, hopeful voice, slightly fast

beats.caption: volume thoda kam karo
beats.style: an annoyed, exasperated, highly expressive voice, slightly high pitched

beats.text: Like millions of people in India, Aarav speaks Hinglish. Most voice assistants do not.
beats.style: a gently amused, wry and expressive voice at a moderate pace

beats.text: This is Myna, a voice assistant built on Bolo. It is small enough to live on his laptop, and it understands Hinglish.
beats.style: a bright, excited, highly expressive voice, slightly high pitched and a bit fast, like revealing a surprise

beats.caption: client folder mein terminal kholo
beats.style: a curious, slightly doubtful voice at a moderate pace

beats.text: Myna writes down what he said, works out what he wants, and checks that the folder really exists. Then the terminal opens.
beats.style: a lively, animated, highly expressive voice, slightly fast, with rising energy

beats.text: It knows twenty kinds of commands. Music, timers, reminders, messages, settings, and more.
beats.style: a playful, cheerful, highly expressive voice, fast paced

beats.text: And when it is not sure, it asks, instead of guessing.
beats.style: a warm, knowing, slightly playful voice, slow and expressive

beats.text: Everything runs on the laptop itself. No internet, no cloud. His voice never leaves his machine.
beats.style: a calm, confident and reassuring voice, slightly low pitched, slow

beats.text: On {N_WORDS} test commands, spoken in computer voices it never trained on, Myna picked the right action {E2E_WORDS} percent of the time. Real voices are being tested now.
beats.style: a clear, honest, matter of fact voice at a moderate pace

beats.text: Myna, built on Bolo. Open source, and free. Try it, and tell us where it fails.
beats.style: an upbeat, inviting, highly expressive voice, slightly high pitched
